SELECT
    COUNT(device_name) AS current_battery_count
FROM
(
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN is_idle = 0 THEN 'InUse'
            WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN 'NotInUse'
        END AS usage_status
    FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod
) t
WHERE timestamp =
(
    SELECT MAX(timestamp)
    FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod
)
AND city IN (${City:sqlstring})
AND oem IN (${OEM:sqlstring})
AND vehicle IN (${Vehicle:sqlstring})
AND dealer_name IN (${Dealer_Name:sqlstring})
AND device_model IN (${Device_Model:sqlstring})
AND usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring})

SELECT
    device_name AS "device name",
    daily_cycle_count AS "daily_cycle_count",
    timestamp AS "time"
FROM
(
    SELECT
        *,
        if(is_idle = 0, 'InUse', 'NotInUse') AS usage_status
    FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod
) AS t
WHERE
    daily_cycle_count > 3
    AND city IN (${City:sqlstring})
    AND oem IN (${OEM:sqlstring})
    AND vehicle IN (${Vehicle:sqlstring})
    AND dealer_name IN (${Dealer_Name:sqlstring})
    AND device_model IN (${Device_Model:sqlstring})
    AND usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC;

    WHEN avg_temp >= 25 AND avg_temp < 30  THEN '25-30'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 30 AND avg_temp < 35  THEN '30-35'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 35 AND avg_temp < 40  THEN '35-40'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 40 AND avg_temp < 45  THEN '40-45'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 45 AND avg_temp < 50  THEN '45-50'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 50 AND avg_temp < 55  THEN '50-55'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 55 AND avg_temp < 60  THEN '55-60'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 60 AND avg_temp < 65  THEN '60-65'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 65 AND avg_temp < 70  THEN '65-70'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 70 AND avg_temp < 75  THEN '70-75'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 75 AND avg_temp < 80  THEN '75-80'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 80 AND avg_temp < 85  THEN '80-85'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 85 AND avg_temp < 90  THEN '85-90'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 90 AND avg_temp < 95  THEN '90-95'
    WHEN avg_temp >= 95 AND avg_temp <= 100 THEN '95-100'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS temp_bucket,

  COUNT(*) AS device_count,

  ROUND(
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 /
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (),
    2
  ) AS percentage

FROM device_avg

WHERE usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring})

GROUP BY temp_bucket

HAVING temp_bucket IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY temp_bucket;

WITH device_avg AS (
  SELECT
    device_name,
    AVG(daily_soc_avg) AS avg_soc,
    CASE
        WHEN is_idle = 0 THEN 'InUse'
        WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN 'NotInUse'
    END AS usage_status
  FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod
  WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
    AND city IN (${City:sqlstring})
    AND oem IN (${OEM:sqlstring})
    AND vehicle IN (${Vehicle:sqlstring})
    AND dealer_name IN (${Dealer_Name:sqlstring})
    AND device_model IN (${Device_Model:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY device_name, is_idle
)

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN avg_soc >= 0  AND avg_soc < 20  THEN '0-20'
    WHEN avg_soc >= 20 AND avg_soc < 40  THEN '20-40'
    WHEN avg_soc >= 40 AND avg_soc < 60  THEN '40-60'
    WHEN avg_soc >= 60 AND avg_soc < 80  THEN '60-80'
    WHEN avg_soc >= 80 AND avg_soc <= 100 THEN '80-100'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS soc_bucket,

  COUNT(device_name) AS device_count,

  ROUND(
    COUNT(device_name) * 100.0 /
    SUM(COUNT(device_name)) OVER (),
    2
  ) AS percentage

FROM device_avg

WHERE usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring})

GROUP BY soc_bucket

HAVING soc_bucket <> 'Other'

ORDER BY soc_bucket;

WITH device_avg AS (
  SELECT
    device_name,
    AVG(T_1_6_avg) AS avg_temp,
    CASE
      WHEN is_idle = 0 THEN 'InUse'
      WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN 'NotInUse'
    END AS usage_status

  FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod

  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND city IN (${City:sqlstring})
    AND oem IN (${OEM:sqlstring})
    AND vehicle IN (${Vehicle:sqlstring})
    AND dealer_name IN (${Dealer_Name:sqlstring})
    AND device_model IN (${Device_Model:sqlstring})
    AND is_active = 1

  GROUP BY
    device_name,
    is_idle
)

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(avg_temp), 2) AS weighted_overall_avg_temp

FROM device_avg

WHERE usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring});

WITH device_avg AS (
    SELECT
        device_name,
        AVG(daily_soc_avg) AS avg_soc,
        CASE
            WHEN is_idle = 0 THEN 'InUse'
            WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN 'NotInUse'
        END AS usage_status
    FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND city IN (${City:sqlstring})
      AND oem IN (${OEM:sqlstring})
      AND vehicle IN (${Vehicle:sqlstring})
      AND dealer_name IN (${Dealer_Name:sqlstring})
      AND device_model IN (${Device_Model:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY device_name, is_idle
)

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(avg_soc), 2) AS weighted_overall_avg_soc
FROM device_avg
WHERE usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring});

SELECT
    latest_update_time AS time,
    effective_range
FROM battery_analytics.cehive_raw_telemetry_v6
WHERE
    device_name IN (${battery:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(latest_update_time)
ORDER BY latest_update_time

SELECT
    countIf(current_cell_v_min < 2900) AS count_below_2900,
    countIf(current_cell_v_min < 2600) AS count_below_2600,
    timestamp AS time
FROM
(
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN is_idle = 0 THEN 'InUse'
            WHEN is_idle = 1 THEN 'NotInUse'
        END AS usage_status
    FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod
) AS t
WHERE
    city IN (${City:sqlstring})
    AND oem IN (${OEM:sqlstring})
    AND vehicle IN (${Vehicle:sqlstring})
    AND dealer_name IN (${Dealer_Name:sqlstring})
    AND device_model IN (${Device_Model:sqlstring})
    AND usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring})
GROUP BY timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp DESC

SELECT
    device_name AS "Device Name",
    current_cell_v_min,
    timestamp AS "time"
FROM
(
    SELECT
        *,
        if(is_idle = 0, 'InUse', 'NotInUse') AS usage_status
    FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod
) AS t
WHERE
    current_cell_v_min < 2900
    AND city IN (${City:sqlstring})
    AND oem IN (${OEM:sqlstring})
    AND vehicle IN (${Vehicle:sqlstring})
    AND dealer_name IN (${Dealer_Name:sqlstring})
    AND device_model IN (${Device_Model:sqlstring})
    AND usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC;

SELECT
    COUNT(device_name) AS "count",
    MAX(effective_range) AS max_effective_range,
    AVG(effective_range) AS avg_effective_range,
    MIN(effective_range) AS min_effective_range,
    timestamp AS "time"
FROM
(
    SELECT
        *,
        if(is_idle = 0, 'InUse', 'NotInUse') AS usage_status
    FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod
) AS t
WHERE
    city IN (${City:sqlstring})
    AND oem IN (${OEM:sqlstring})
    AND vehicle IN (${Vehicle:sqlstring})
    AND dealer_name IN (${Dealer_Name:sqlstring})
    AND device_model IN (${Device_Model:sqlstring})
    AND usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring})
    AND effective_range > 0
    AND effective_range < 500
GROUP BY timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT
    MIN(effective_range) AS "min_effective_range",
    AVG(effective_range) AS "avg_effective_range",
    MAX(effective_range) AS "max_effective_range",
    COUNT(device_name) AS "count",
    timestamp AS "time"
FROM
(
    SELECT
        (
            (new_effective_range_end_odometer - new_effective_range_start_odometer) /
            ((new_effective_range_start_soc - new_effective_range_end_soc) * 0.01)
        ) AS effective_range,
        device_name,
        timestamp
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            *,
            if(is_idle = 0, 'InUse', 'NotInUse') AS usage_status
        FROM battery_analytics.telemetry_prod
    ) AS p
    WHERE
        city IN (${City:sqlstring})
        AND oem IN (${OEM:sqlstring})
        AND vehicle IN (${Vehicle:sqlstring})
        AND dealer_name IN (${Dealer_Name:sqlstring})
        AND device_model IN (${Device_Model:sqlstring})
        AND usage_status IN (${Usage_Status:sqlstring})
        AND (new_effective_range_start_soc - new_effective_range_end_soc) >= 30
        AND new_effective_range_end_odometer >= new_effective_range_start_odometer
) AS t
WHERE
    effective_range < 500
GROUP BY timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp;
